help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%, enhances the sleep duration by {Boost.Attrib.Sleep.Scale}%, reduces endurance cost by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}% and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy and Sleep Duration, Increases Attack Rate, and Reduces Endurance Cost
